correctness.rationale: Every point x is contained in exactly 4/h distinct translates, so depth >=3 requires h=1. Given h=1, depth3 requires a positive-branch split 2/2 on queries x,y, equivalent to |A∩(A+y−x)|=2. Then four joint-label populations are 2,2,2,N−6, all ≥2 for N≥8, hence each supports a final separating query; no depth4 because the positive branch has at most four hypotheses. h=4 yields depth1, all other cases depth2. At prime p≥11 Sidon translates are exactly absence of repeated off-diagonal differences; r(t)=3 forces r(2t)=2, giving the dichotomy. Normalized (13,4,1) difference sets are exactly four, each with 13 translates, giving 52 of 715 Sidon supports. Independent enumeration verified p11 has zero and p13 52 such sets, matching proof.
